meta.title: Vietnam Scams 2026: The Game Has Changed
meta.description:
I thought I knew Vietnam. I’ve traveled North to South, my wife is Vietnamese, and I figured I had the "street smarts" figured out. But as we prepare to move our entire family there next week, I realized something important: The game has changed.

The things I could laugh off as a solo backpacker are completely different now that I have a 4-year-old son next to me.

In this video, I’m breaking down the 4 specific scams I am genuinely watching out for in 2026. These aren't just the old "overpriced coconut" tricks—these are the ones that target your confusion at the airport, your unfamiliarity with the currency, and the safety of your family.

From the "Fake Grab" drivers at Tan Son Nhat to the rental nightmare that keeps me up at night, here is how I plan to avoid them (and how you can too).

🎥 Watch Next: 5 Lies Keeping You From Vietnam https://youtu.be/1SW8n7WKF48




About this video: I've traveled solo and as a family through Vietnam to find out if it's actually safe for American tourists. From the busy streets of Ho Chi Minh City to the rice paddies of the countryside, the truth surprised us. Whether you are worried about safety, hygiene, or anti-American sentiment, this video covers the honest truth about traveling Vietnam in 2026.

#VietnamTravel #VietnamMyths #TravelTips #FamilyTravel #Vietnam2026
